city.title: City or place
city.description: Anywhere on earth, e.g. Lisbon, Portugal or Austin, Texas. The boundary is resolved for you. Ignored if you give a bounding box or a radius.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: restaurant, cafe, bar, pub, fast_food, hotel, guest_house, hostel, supermarket, convenience, bakery, butcher, clothing, hairdresser, beauty, pharmacy, doctor, dentist, hospital, veterinary, bank, atm, fuel, ev_charging, gym, coworking, car_dealer, car_repair, electronics, furniture, hardware, florist, optician, school, kindergarten, cinema, museum.

boundingBox.title: Bounding box (optional)
boundingBox.description: south,west,north,east in decimal degrees. Overrides the city, and is the precise way to cover a district or a delivery zone.

latitude.title: Latitude (optional)
latitude.description: Decimal degrees, e.g. 52.52. Use with longitude and radius to search around a point instead of an area.

longitude.title: Longitude (optional)
longitude.description: Decimal degrees, e.g. 13.405. Use with latitude and radius.

radiusMeters.title: Radius in metres (optional)
radiusMeters.description: Search this far around the point. Up to 50000.

brand.title: Brand filter (optional)
brand.description: Keep only places carrying this brand, e.g. Starbucks, Lidl, Shell. Case insensitive.

requireWebsite.title: Only places with a website
requireWebsite.description: Useful when the output feeds outreach rather than a map.

requirePhone.title: Only places with a phone number
requirePhone.description: Keep only listings carrying a phone number.

requireOpeningHours.title: Only places with opening hours
requireOpeningHours.description: A rough proxy for how well maintained a listing is.

maxResults.title: Max places per run
maxResults.description: Cap on places returned. Controls total cost.
